lines: Built with: vite.config.ts, package.json declares @nextcloud/vite-config ^1.5.6 (locked 1.7.2), vite ^7.3.6 (locked 7.3.6).
Written against: @nextcloud/vue 8.40.0, 25 delivered packages; vue 2.7.16, 6 delivered packages.
Other delivered libraries: 4, vite-plugin-node-polyfills 0.24.0, vue-material-design-icons 5.3.1, toastify-js 1.12.0, @vue/devtools-api 6.6.3.

90 delivered files carry no source map, 1 file does. The bytes of the unmapped ones are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: a copy of a file of the checkout, the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
4 packages are imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
